reason: the 180 degree turn between passes took 17.56 s, measured over the nine turns of a 100 m run, and it happens with the shutter closed. On a 20 m region it cost more than the pass it separated.

where_the_time_went.reading: the turn was rate limited, not alignment limited: 84% of it was spent driving and the command sat within 10% of its peak for 47.6% of the time. The shift is the opposite -- only 36% driving -- so raising the 0.5 m/s translate speed would not have helped and was left alone.

changed.note: the real ceiling, through min(request, angular_speed_rad_s, max_yaw_rate). It was the only figure in that file with no derivation; 0.90 rad/s asks 0.72 m/s of each wheel in place (omega * hypot(wheelbase/2, track/2) = 0.802 m), 17% of max_speed
it was written twice behind a min(), so changing either one alone did nothing
